# `mcp-scaffold add-mcp-app`

- **Usage**: `mcp-scaffold add-mcp-app [FLAGS] <name>`

Add a second app to apps/<name>/ (name used as given) inside an existing scaffolded repo

## Arguments

### `<name>`

Name for the new app, used as given (foo → apps/foo, bin foo)

## Flags

### `--target <dir>`

Path to the scaffolded repo

### `--scope <scope>`

Npm scope, with leading @. Auto-detected from an existing apps/* package if omitted.

### `--no-tui`

Skip the Ink/React TUI surface for the new app

### `--no-install`

Skip the package-manager install after dependencies change

### `--no-http`

Skip the Streamable HTTP transport for the new app

### `--no-rust-accel`

Skip the rust-accel workspace dep for the new app
